claude_proposed_widenings.name: vehicle_control_surface
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item is operated through repeated lever inputs that mutate persistent state and dispatch movement, attacks, and utility effects. No existing magic-item family models a controllable vehicle/object with operator-facing controls.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item mechanics family: vehicle_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The apparatus is a persistent Large object with its own AC, HP, movement, immunities, occupancy, and sealed-compartment rules, not a passive grant, one-shot activation, reaction, or spawned creature.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Apparatus of the Crab is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. if the legs aren't extended); Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: object_or_vehicle_stat_block
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Current creature payloads are for companions/summons, not controllable magic-item vehicles or objects. The unit needs first-class object statistics plus occupancy and compartment properties.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While the apparatus's hatch is closed, the compartment is airtight and watertight. The compartment holds enough air for 10 hours of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.
